assessment.summary: The engine reports a GBP -812.40 bank-ledger difference for SGA-GBP-01 on each of 10 reconciliation dates from 2026-09-17 through 2026-09-30: each C08 result is FAIL, with timing items of 0.00 and residual unexplained difference of -812.40. The engine also reports a FAIL for zero discrepancy-log entries. A GBP 812.40 debit with reference “SETTLE 0417” appears on the 2026-09-17 statement and is reported by the engine as having no cash-book or other specified counterpart. The available evidence does not establish whether that debit is related to the recurring difference or what it represents. The internal reconciliation is a different measure and reports requirement and resource equal with a 0.00 difference; this does not contradict the external bank-ledger reconciliation or explain it.

confirmed_findings.title: Recurring -812.40 external bank-ledger difference
confirmed_findings.description: The engine reports a -812.40 bank-ledger difference on all 10 reconciliation dates in scope, with 0.00 explained by timing and -812.40 residual unexplained on each date.
confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: The C08 control results for 2026-09-17, 2026-09-18, 2026-09-21 through 2026-09-25, and 2026-09-28 through 2026-09-30 each report FAIL and the same values. The external reconciliation records report a -812.40 difference for those dates and do not claim timing differences.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The same reported residual persists across the dates in scope and requires investigation; the engine reports no timing explanation.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The engine reports these FAIL outcomes and values, and the cited firm external-reconciliation records report -812.40 differences on the cited dates.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The records do not establish why the difference arose, whether the repeated amount reflects one underlying item, or whether it relates to the SETTLE 0417 debit.

confirmed_findings.title: 17 September external reconciliation and bank confirmation
confirmed_findings.description: For 2026-09-17, the firm external reconciliation reports a GBP ledger balance of 341484.46 and bank balance of 340672.06; the 17:00 bank balance confirmation reports 340672.06 for the same account and date.
confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: The external reconciliation record reports a -812.40 difference and says no timing difference is claimed. The separate 17:00 confirmation reports the account's bank balance as 340672.06. The engine's C08 result for that date is FAIL at -812.40.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The underlying reported figures identify the bank-ledger scope of the exception and the confirmed bank balance used for that date.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The firm record reports the stated ledger and bank balances, and the 17:00 confirmation reports the same bank balance for SGA-GBP-01 on 2026-09-17.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: These records do not establish the reason for the reported ledger-bank difference or independently verify the firm's ledger balance.

confirmed_findings.title: Internal reconciliation reports no requirement-resource difference
confirmed_findings.description: The 2026-09-17 internal reconciliation reports GBP requirement and resource of 341484.46 each and a difference of 0.00.
confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: The internal reconciliation is for the GBP asset pool at the 17:00 reconciliation point. It compares requirement with resource, which is a different measure from the external reconciliation's comparison of the account ledger balance with its bank balance.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: This separate reconciliation view is relevant context but does not explain the external bank-ledger exception.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The firm internal reconciliation reports equal requirement and resource and a 0.00 difference for GBP on 2026-09-17.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish that the bank balance equals the ledger balance, nor does it resolve or contradict the external bank-ledger difference.

confirmed_findings.title: Unmatched 812.40 bank debit on 17 September
confirmed_findings.description: The 2026-09-17 bank statement includes a GBP 812.40 debit with bank reference and narrative “SETTLE 0417”; the engine reports FAIL results for no cash-book counterpart and no batch, transaction, top-up, or register counterpart.
confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: The bank entry has no counterparty name and is on the 2026-09-17 end-of-day statement. A cash-book search for the exact reference returned NOT_FOUND, and the packet's search for other records carrying that reference also returned NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The debit's amount and date make it relevant to investigate alongside the difference, but no evidence-backed link between them is established.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The statement entry is a GBP 812.40 debit with the stated reference and narrative; the engine reports the stated unmatched-counterpart FAIL results, and the cited searches did not find matching records.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: The evidence does not establish the debit's purpose, payee, authorization, cash-book treatment, or relationship to the recurring bank-ledger difference.

confirmed_findings.title: No discrepancy-log entries found for the records in scope

confirmed_findings.evidence_relationship: The discrepancy-log control result is FAIL and reports 0 log entries. The search for entries referencing the ten external reconciliation records returned NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The packet lacks recorded investigation evidence for the reported differences.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The engine reports zero log entries, and the search for entries referencing the in-scope external reconciliation records returned NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: This does not establish whether investigation activity occurred outside the supplied log data or why no entries were found.
